title: RefactoringPlan
description:
The refactoring plan produced by the RDP agent (Agent 2) from a FilteredCUQAReport, normalized by the Orchestration Agent (backend/domain/plan_normalizer.py::normalize_rdp_plan) and returned as `plan` from POST /api/workflows/<id>/select-smells.

Two normalizations are applied to what RDP sends, and both matter:

  1. RDP serializes `summary` as a human-readable STRING; every DIWO stage reads plan.summary.total_steps. The object form is built here and the original text is preserved as `summary_text`.
  2. RDP flattens every path to its basename while translating the report, so a plan comes back naming 'Helper.java' where the report said 'src/util/Helper.java'. The repository-relative paths are restored, because the Transformation stage resolves them against the CUQA workspace. Names that appear on more than one path are left alone — guessing between two Helper.java would point a refactoring at the wrong file.

The decision data the approval screen renders (impact, risk, MCDA score) is NOT on the steps: it lives in RDP's separate `trace`, and the frontend folds it back on with utils/planTrace.js::enrichPlanWithTrace.

target.description: What the plan is named after. RDP takes this from files[0] of the report it was given, which is why build_rdp_plan_input drops files with no selected smells.

source.description: Which planner produced this. 'diwo_local_fallback' is the offline generator in backend/domain/plan_normalizer.py, used only when the RDP agent is unreachable or refuses the report. The response also carries `plan_source` and `plan_warning` alongside the plan so a fallback is never mistaken for real RDP output.

summary_text.description: RDP's own human-readable summary, preserved because normalization replaces `summary` with the object form.

total_steps.description: Always recomputed from steps.length, never carried over.

step_id.description: Stable within a plan. The approved plan keeps the original ids so every action SCTVA reports traces back to the step the developer reviewed.

smell_id.description: The smell this step addresses. RDP re-keys smells internally ('smell_003'), so this does NOT always match the CUQA-style <path>:<line>:<index> id — join through the trace's input_summary when the original smell is needed.

refactoring.description: Human-readable refactoring name, e.g. 'Extract Method'. backend/domain/sctva_mapper.py maps it onto the SCTVA action vocabulary; an unmapped name becomes a noop rather than disappearing.

file.description: Repository-relative path, restored after RDP's basename flattening.

parameters.description: Refactoring-specific arguments. The key set depends on the refactoring — see map_step in backend/domain/sctva_mapper.py for which keys each SCTVA action requires.
